data.title: Safety Bracelet Service Enhances Care for Children, Elderly, and Persons with Disabilities at Grand Mosque
data.content:
Makkah, November 15, 2026, SPA -- The General Authority for the Care of the Affairs of the Grand Mosque and the Prophet's Mosque is offering a safety bracelet service for visitors to the Grand Mosque to assist in locating children, older people, and people with disabilities should they become separated from their companions, ensuring their safety while they are within the Grand Mosque and its courtyards.
    The service is provided free of charge through the guest care centers. Beneficiaries are given bracelets containing identification details, which enable staff on the ground to identify them and contact their families when necessary.
    This initiative reflects the authority’s commitment to prioritizing safety and humanitarian care, ensuring a secure and accessible environment for all who visit the Grand Mosque, thereby facilitating their journey and allowing them to perform their acts of worship with peace of mind.
    -- SPA
